ABSORB.name: Поглинання
ABSORB.effect: Атака, що висмоктує поживні речовини. ОЗ користувача відновлюється на ½ від шкоди, завданої цим прийомом.

ACCELEROCK.name: Accelerock
ACCELEROCK.effect: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.

ACID.name: Кислота
ACID.effect: На поке́монів супротивників наноситься удар у вигляді струменя їдкої кислоти. Цей прийом має 10% шанс знизити їхній показник Спец. Захисту

ACID_ARMOR.name: Acid Armor
ACID_ARMOR.effect: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

ACID_SPRAY.name: Acid Spray
ACID_SPRAY.effect: The user attacks by spitting fluid that works to melt the target. This also harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

ACROBATICS.name: Acrobatics
ACROBATICS.effect: The user nimbly strikes the target. The fewer held items, the higher the damage it inflicts (ranging between 55 and 110).

AERIAL_ACE.name: Aerial Ace
AERIAL_ACE.effect: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

AEROBLAST.name: Aeroblast
AEROBLAST.effect: A vortex of air is shot at the target to inflict damage. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

AGILITY.name: Передбачування
AGILITY.effect: Користувач розслабляється і полегшує своє тіло, щоб рухатися швидше. Це різко підвищує його показник швидкості.

AIR_CUTTER.name: Air Cutter
AIR_CUTTER.effect: The user launches razor-like wind to slash opposing Pokémon. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

AIR_SLASH.name: Air Slash
AIR_SLASH.effect: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

ALLURING_VOICE.name: Alluring Voice
ALLURING_VOICE.effect: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.

AMNESIA.name: Amnesia
AMNESIA.effect: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply boosts the user’s Sp. Def stat.

ANCHOR_SHOT.name: Anchor Shot
ANCHOR_SHOT.effect: The user entangles the target with its anchor chain while attacking. The target becomes unable to flee or switched out of battle.

ANCIENT_POWER.name: Ancient Power
ANCIENT_POWER.effect: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This has a 10% chance of boosting the user’s Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats all at once.

APPLE_ACID.name: Apple Acid
APPLE_ACID.effect: The user attacks the target with an acidic liquid created from tart apples. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

AQUA_CUTTER.name: Aqua Cutter
AQUA_CUTTER.effect: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

AQUA_JET.name: Aqua Jet
AQUA_JET.effect: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

AQUA_STEP.name: Аква-Крок
AQUA_STEP.effect: Користувач дражнить супротивника і атакує його легкими, плавними танцювальними рухами. Це також підвищує показник швидкості користувача.

AQUA_TAIL.name: Aqua Tail
AQUA_TAIL.effect: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

ARMOR_CANNON.name: Armor Cannon
ARMOR_CANNON.effect: The user attacks by shooting off its own armor as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

ARM_THRUST.name: Arm Thrust
ARM_THRUST.effect: The user attacks the target with open-palmed arm thrusts. This move hits 2-5 times in a row.

AROMATHERAPY.name: Aromatherapy
AROMATHERAPY.effect: The user releases a soothing scent to cure the status conditions of all its fellow party Pokémon and allies.

AROMATIC_MIST.name: Aromatic Mist
AROMATIC_MIST.effect: The user boosts the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.

ASSURANCE.name: Assurance
ASSURANCE.effect: This move’s power is doubled if the target has already taken some damage in the same turn.

ASTONISH.name: Astonish
ASTONISH.effect: The user attacks the target by crying out in a startling fashion. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

ASTRAL_BARRAGE.name: Astral Barrage
ASTRAL_BARRAGE.effect: The user attacks by sending a frightful amount of small ghosts at opposing Pokémon.

ATTACK_ORDER.name: Attack Order
ATTACK_ORDER.effect: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the target. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

AURA_SPHERE.name: Aura Sphere
AURA_SPHERE.effect: The user lets loose a pulse of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.

AURORA_BEAM.name: Аврора Промінь
AURORA_BEAM.effect: Ціль потрапляє під дію променя кольору веселки. Цей прийом має 10% шанс знизити показник Атаки цілі.

AURORA_VEIL.name: Aurora Veil
AURORA_VEIL.effect: This move halves the damage taken from physical and special moves for 5 turns. In Double Battles, this damage is reduced by ⅓ instead. This can be used only under hail or when it is snowing.

AUTOTOMIZE.name: Autotomize
AUTOTOMIZE.effect: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter. This sharply boosts the user’s Speed stat.

AVALANCHE.name: Avalanche
AVALANCHE.effect: The user moves last. The power of this move is doubled if the target has inflicted damage on the user in the same turn.

AXE_KICK.name: Axe Kick
AXE_KICK.effect: The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This move has a 30% chance of confusing the target. If this move misses or fails, the user takes damage equal to ½ of its max HP instead.

BABY_DOLL_EYES.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
BABY_DOLL_EYES.effect: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers the target’s Attack stat. This move always goes first.

BADDY_BAD.name: Baddy Bad
BADDY_BAD.effect: The user acts bad and attacks the target. A wondrous wall of light is put up to halve the damage taken from physical moves. In Double Battles, this damage is reduced by ⅓ instead.

BANEFUL_BUNKER.name: Baneful Bunker
BANEFUL_BUNKER.effect: The user protects itself from incoming moves for the turn. Any attackers that use contact moves against the user during this turn become poisoned. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

BARB_BARRAGE.name: Barb Barrage
BARB_BARRAGE.effect: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This move has a 50% chance of poisoning the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target is already poisoned.

BARRIER.name: Barrier
BARRIER.effect: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply boosts its Defense stat.

BEHEMOTH_BLADE.name: Behemoth Blade
BEHEMOTH_BLADE.effect: The user wields a large, powerful sword using its whole body and cuts the target in a vigorous attack.

BELLY_DRUM.name: Belly Drum
BELLY_DRUM.effect: The user loses ½ of its max HP to maximize its Attack stat. This move fails if the user doesn’t have enough remaining HP.

BIND.name: Зв’язувати
BIND.effect: Довге тіло, щупальця тощо використовуються для того, щоб зв’язати та стиснути ціль. Протягом 4–5 ходів ціль отримує наприкінці кожного ходу шкоду, що дорівнює ⅛ від її максимального ОЗ.

BITE.name: Укус
BITE.effect: Ціль отримує укус надзвичайно гострими іклами. Цей прийом має 30% шанс змусити ціль збитися з дії.

BITTER_BLADE.name: Bitter Blade
BITTER_BLADE.effect: The user attacks by focusing all its bitter feelings toward this world into a slashing attack. The user’s HP is restored by ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

BITTER_MALICE.name: Bitter Malice
BITTER_MALICE.effect: The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

BLAST_BURN.name: Blast Burn
BLAST_BURN.effect: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user can’t move on the next turn.

BLAZE_KICK.name: Blaze Kick
BLAZE_KICK.effect: The user attacks with a kick that has a 10% chance of burning the target. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

BLEAKWIND_STORM.name: Bleakwind Storm
BLEAKWIND_STORM.effect: The user attacks with savagely cold winds that cause both body and spirit to tremble. This move has a 30% chance of lowering the Speed stats of opposing Pokémon, and never misses in rain.

BLIZZARD.name: Хуртовина
BLIZZARD.effect: Викликається виюча хуртовина, яка нападає на поке́монів супротивника. Цей прийом має 10% шанс заморозити ціль і ніколи не промахується в умовах снігу чи граду.

BLUE_FLARE.name: Blue Flare
BLUE_FLARE.effect: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense, yet beautiful, blue flame. This move has a 20% chance of burning the target.

BODY_PRESS.name: Body Press
BODY_PRESS.effect: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The damage dealt by this move is determined using the user’s Defense stat instead of its Attack stat.

BODY_SLAM.name: Удар Тілом
BODY_SLAM.effect: Користувач атакує, накидаючись на ціль усією вагою свого тіла. Цей прийом має 30% шанс паралізувати ціль. Якщо ціль застосувала «Зменшення», сила цього прийому подвоюється, і він обов’язково влучить.

BOLT_STRIKE.name: Bolt Strike
BOLT_STRIKE.effect: The user surrounds itself with a great amount of electricity and charges the target. This move has a 20% chance of paralyzing the target.

BONE_RUSH.name: Bone Rush
BONE_RUSH.effect: The user attacks by striking the target with a hard bone. This move hits 2-5 times in a row.

BOOMBURST.name: Boomburst
BOOMBURST.effect: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible explosive sound.

BOUNCE.name: Bounce
BOUNCE.effect: The user bounces up high on the first turn, then drops onto the target on the next turn. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target.

BOUNCY_BUBBLE.name: Bouncy Bubble
BOUNCY_BUBBLE.effect: The user attacks by shooting water bubbles at the target. It then absorbs water and restores its HP by 100% of the damage dealt by this move.

BRANCH_POKE.name: Branch Poke
BRANCH_POKE.effect: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.

BRAVE_BIRD.name: Brave Bird
BRAVE_BIRD.effect: The user tucks in its wings and charges at a low altitude. The user takes ⅓ of the damage dealt by this move.

BREAKING_SWIPE.name: Breaking Swipe
BREAKING_SWIPE.effect: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.

BRICK_BREAK.name: Brick Break
BRICK_BREAK.effect: The user attacks with a swift chop. This move can also break barriers such as Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil.

BRINE.name: Brine
BRINE.effect: This move’s power is doubled if the target’s HP is at half or less.

BRUTAL_SWING.name: Brutal Swing
BRUTAL_SWING.effect: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

BUBBLE.name: Bubble
BUBBLE.effect: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the opposing Pokémon. This move has a 10% chance of lowering their Speed stats.

BUBBLE_BEAM.name: Бульбашковий Промінь
BUBBLE_BEAM.effect: У бік цілі потужно вистрілюється струмінь бульбашок. Цей прийом має 10% шанс знизити показник швидкості цілі.

BUG_BITE.name: Bug Bite
BUG_BITE.effect: The user attacks by biting the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

BUG_BUZZ.name: Bug Buzz
BUG_BUZZ.effect: The user vibrates to generate a damaging sound wave. This move has a 10% chance of lowering the target’s Sp. Def stat.

BULK_UP.name: Bulk Up
BULK_UP.effect: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.

BULLDOZE.name: Bulldoze
BULLDOZE.effect: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

BULLET_PUNCH.name: Bullet Punch
BULLET_PUNCH.effect: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.

BULLET_SEED.name: Bullet Seed
BULLET_SEED.effect: The user attacks by forcefully shooting seeds at the target. This move hits 2-5 times in a row.

BURNING_BULWARK.name: Burning Bulwark
BURNING_BULWARK.effect: The user intensely heats up a part of its body, protecting it from attacks and also causing burns to any attacker that makes direct contact with it.

BURNING_JEALOUSY.name: Burning Jealousy
BURNING_JEALOUSY.effect: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.

BUZZY_BUZZ.name: Buzzy Buzz
BUZZY_BUZZ.effect: The user shoots a jolt of electricity to attack the target. This also paralyzes the target.

CALM_MIND.name: Calm Mind
CALM_MIND.effect: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

CAPTIVATE.name: Captivate
CAPTIVATE.effect: If any opposing Pokémon is the opposite gender of the user, it is charmed, which harshly lowers its Sp. Atk stat.

CEASELESS_EDGE.name: Ceaseless Edge
CEASELESS_EDGE.effect: The user slashes a sharpened blade at the target, leaving splinters under the target as spikes. Pokémon that switch into battle take damage equal to ⅛ of their max HP. Up to three layers can be set, with each layer increasing the damage taken. Flying types or Pokémon with Levitate are unaffected by these spikes.

CHARGE.name: Charge
CHARGE.effect: The user becomes charged, doubling the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Def stat.

CHARGE_BEAM.name: Charge Beam
CHARGE_BEAM.effect: The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The residual electricity has a 70% chance of boosting the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

CHARM.name: Charm
CHARM.effect: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target’s Attack stat.

CHILLING_WATER.name: Chilling Water
CHILLING_WATER.effect: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that’s so cold it saps the target’s power. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

CHIP_AWAY.name: Chip Away
CHIP_AWAY.effect: Looking for an opening, the user strikes consistently. This move ignores the target’s stat changes when dealing damage.

CLAMP.name: Clamp
CLAMP.effect: The target is clamped and squeezed by the user’s very thick and sturdy shell. For 4-5 turns, the target takes damage equal to ⅛ of its max HP at the end of every turn.

CLANGING_SCALES.name: Clanging Scales
CLANGING_SCALES.effect: The user rubs the scales on its entire body and makes a huge noise to attack opposing Pokémon. The user’s Defense stat is lowered after the attack.

CLANGOROUS_SOUL.name: Clangorous Soul
CLANGOROUS_SOUL.effect: The user loses ⅓ of its max HP to boost its Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats. This move fails if the user doesn’t have enough remaining HP.

CLEAR_SMOG.name: Clear Smog
CLEAR_SMOG.effect: The user attacks the target by throwing a clump of special mud. All stat changes are eliminated.

CLOSE_COMBAT.name: Close Combat
CLOSE_COMBAT.effect: The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

COACHING.name: Coaching
COACHING.effect: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

COIL.name: Coil
COIL.effect: The user coils up and concentrates. This boosts its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.

COLLISION_COURSE.name: Collision Course
COLLISION_COURSE.effect: The user rushes forward and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move’s power is boosted by 33% if it’s a supereffective hit.

CONFIDE.name: Confide
CONFIDE.effect: The user tells the target a secret, and the target loses its ability to concentrate. This lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

CONFUSE_RAY.name: Зловісний Промінь
CONFUSE_RAY.effect: Користувач направляє на ціль зловісний промінь, що збиває її з пантелику.

CONFUSION.name: Плутанина
CONFUSION.effect: На ціль діє слабка телекінетична сила, що завдає їй шкоди. Цей прийом має 10% шанс заплутати ціль

CONSTRICT.name: Constrict
CONSTRICT.effect: The target is attacked with long, creeping tentacles, vines, or the like. This move has a 10% chance of lowering the target’s Speed stat.

CORE_ENFORCER.name: Core Enforcer
CORE_ENFORCER.effect: The user attacks by firing off a powerful beam that scorches across the battlefield. If the Pokémon damaged by this move have already used their moves that turn, this move eliminates the effects of those Pokémon’s Abilities.

COSMIC_POWER.name: Cosmic Power
COSMIC_POWER.effect: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to boost its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

COTTON_GUARD.name: Cotton Guard
COTTON_GUARD.effect: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, drastically boosting its Defense stat.

COTTON_SPORE.name: Cotton Spore
COTTON_SPORE.effect: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to opposing Pokémon. This harshly lowers their Speed stats.

COVET.name: Covet
COVET.effect: The user endearingly approaches the target, then tries to steal from the target. This move has a 30% chance to steal one of the target’s held items.

CRABHAMMER.name: Crabhammer
CRABHAMMER.effect: The target is hammered with a large pincer. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

CROSS_CHOP.name: Cross Chop
CROSS_CHOP.effect: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

CROSS_POISON.name: Cross Poison
CROSS_POISON.effect: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that has a 10% chance of poisoning the target. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

CRUNCH.name: Crunch
CRUNCH.effect: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This move has a 20% chance of lowering the target’s Defense stat.

CRUSH_CLAW.name: Crush Claw
CRUSH_CLAW.effect: The user slashes the target with hard and sharp claws. This move has a 50% chance of lowering the target’s Defense stat.

DARKEST_LARIAT.name: Darkest Lariat
DARKEST_LARIAT.effect: The user swings both arms and hits the target. This move ignores the target’s stat changes when dealing damage.

DARK_PULSE.name: Dark Pulse
DARK_PULSE.effect: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This move has a 20% chance of making the target flinch.

DAZZLING_GLEAM.name: Dazzling Gleam
DAZZLING_GLEAM.effect: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

DEFENSE_CURL.name: Defense Curl
DEFENSE_CURL.effect: The user curls up to conceal weak spots, which boosts its Defense stat. This also doubles the power of Rollout and Ice Ball.

DEFOG.name: Defog
DEFOG.effect: A strong wind blows away the target’s barriers such as Light Screen, Reflect, Aurora Veil, or Safeguard, as well as any entry hazards or terrain from the field. This also lowers the target’s evasiveness, and can clear deep fog.

DETECT.name: Detect
DETECT.effect: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

DIAMOND_STORM.name: Diamond Storm
DIAMOND_STORM.effect: The user attacks by engulfing targets in a storm of diamonds. This move has a 50% chance to sharply boost the user’s Defense stat.

DIG.name: Копання
DIG.effect: У першому ході користувач заривається в землю, а в наступному — атакує.

DIRE_CLAW.name: Dire Claw
DIRE_CLAW.effect: The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws. This move has a 30% chance of leaving the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.

DISARMING_VOICE.name: Disarming Voice
DISARMING_VOICE.effect: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

DISCHARGE.name: Discharge
DISCHARGE.effect: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing targets.

DIVE.name: Dive
DIVE.effect: The user dives on the first turn, then floats up and attacks on the next turn.

DIZZY_PUNCH.name: Dizzy Punch
DIZZY_PUNCH.effect: The target is hit with rhythmically launched punches. This move has a 20% chance of confusing the target.

DOUBLE_EDGE.name: Відчайдушний Ризик
DOUBLE_EDGE.effect: Необережний прийом, що ставить під загрозу життя, під час якого виконавець кидається на ціль. Користувач отримує ⅓ від шкоди, завданої цим прийомом.

DOUBLE_HIT.name: Double Hit
DOUBLE_HIT.effect: The user slams the target with a tail or the like. The target is hit twice in a row.

DOUBLE_KICK.name: Подвійний Пінок
DOUBLE_KICK.effect: Користувач атакує, завдаючи ціллю два удари поспіль обома ногами.

DOUBLE_SHOCK.name: Double Shock
DOUBLE_SHOCK.effect: The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack, and loses the Electric type. This move fails unless it is used by a Electric type.

DOUBLE_SLAP.name: Подвійний Лапас
DOUBLE_SLAP.effect: По цілі наносять кілька ударів поспіль, туди-сюди, 2–5 разів поспіль.

DOUBLE_TEAM.name: Роздвоєння
DOUBLE_TEAM.effect: Швидко рухаючись, користувач створює ілюзорні копії самого себе, щоб підвищити свій показик ухилення.

DRACO_METEOR.name: Draco Meteor
DRACO_METEOR.effect: Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

DRAGON_ASCENT.name: Dragon Ascent
DRAGON_ASCENT.effect: After soaring upward, the user attacks the target by dropping out of the sky at high speed. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

DRAGON_BREATH.name: Dragon Breath
DRAGON_BREATH.effect: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target.

DRAGON_CLAW.name: Dragon Claw
DRAGON_CLAW.effect: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws to inflict damage.

DRAGON_DANCE.name: Dragon Dance
DRAGON_DANCE.effect: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.

DRAGON_DARTS.name: Dragon Darts
DRAGON_DARTS.effect: The user attacks twice by launching draconic arrows. If there are 2 opposing Pokémon, each of them is attacked once.

DRAGON_HAMMER.name: Dragon Hammer
DRAGON_HAMMER.effect: The user wields its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.

DRAGON_PULSE.name: Dragon Pulse
DRAGON_PULSE.effect: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.

DRAGON_RAGE.name: Гнів Дракона
DRAGON_RAGE.effect: Ця атака вражає ціль ударною хвилею чистої люті. Ця атака завжди завдає 40 очок шкоди.

DRAGON_RUSH.name: Dragon Rush
DRAGON_RUSH.effect: The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. This move has a 20% chance of making the target flinch. If the target has used Minimize, this move’s power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.

DRAGON_TAIL.name: Dragon Tail
DRAGON_TAIL.effect: The user attacks last. In return, the target is knocked away and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

DRAINING_KISS.name: Draining Kiss
DRAINING_KISS.effect: The user steals the target’s HP with a kiss. The user’s HP is restored by ¾ of the damage dealt by this move.

DRAIN_PUNCH.name: Drain Punch
DRAIN_PUNCH.effect: The user attacks with an energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

DRILL_PECK.name: Дрилючий Дзьоб
DRILL_PECK.effect: Атака з обертанням, під час якої ціль вражається гострим дзьобом, що діє як свердло.

DRILL_RUN.name: Drill Run
DRILL_RUN.effect: The user crashes into the target while rotating its body like a drill. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

DRUM_BEATING.name: Drum Beating
DRUM_BEATING.effect: The user plays its drum, controlling the drum’s roots to attack the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

DUAL_CHOP.name: Dual Chop
DUAL_CHOP.effect: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.

DUAL_WINGBEAT.name: Dual Wingbeat
DUAL_WINGBEAT.effect: The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

DYNAMIC_PUNCH.name: Dynamic Punch
DYNAMIC_PUNCH.effect: The user attacks by punching the target with full concentrated power. This also confuses the target.

EARTHQUAKE.name: Землетрус
EARTHQUAKE.effect: Користувач викликає землетрус, який вражає всіх поке́монів навколо нього. Сила цього прийому подвоюється проти цілей, що знаходяться під землею завдяки прийомі «Копання», і зменшується вдвічі, коли діє ефект «Травянисте поле».

EARTH_POWER.name: Earth Power
EARTH_POWER.effect: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This move has a 10% chance of lowering the target’s Sp. Def stat.

ECHOED_VOICE.name: Echoed Voice
ECHOED_VOICE.effect: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. This move’s power is increased by 40 each turn this move is used consecutively by any Pokémon, up to a max of 200.

EERIE_IMPULSE.name: Eerie Impulse
EERIE_IMPULSE.effect: The user’s body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

EGG_BOMB.name: Egg Bomb
EGG_BOMB.effect: A large egg is hurled at the target with maximum force to inflict damage.

ELECTRIC_TERRAIN.name: Electric Terrain
ELECTRIC_TERRAIN.effect: The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for 5 turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground can no longer fall asleep.

ELECTROWEB.name: Electroweb
ELECTROWEB.effect: The user captures opposing Pokémon in an electric net to inflict damage. This also lowers their Speed stats.

ELECTRO_BALL.name: Electro Ball
ELECTRO_BALL.effect: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The higher the user’s Speed stat compared to the target’s, the greater this move’s power (ranging between 40 and 150).

ELECTRO_DRIFT.name: Electro Drift
ELECTRO_DRIFT.effect: The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move’s power is boosted by 33% if it’s a supereffective hit.

EMBER.name: Тліюче Вугілля
EMBER.effect: Ціль атакується невеликими полум’яними язичками. Цей прийом має 10% шанс підпалити ціль.

ENERGY_BALL.name: Energy Ball
ENERGY_BALL.effect: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This move has a 10% chance of lowering the target’s Sp. Def stat.

ERUPTION.name: Eruption
ERUPTION.effect: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with explosive fury. The less HP the user has left, the lower this move’s power (ranging between 1 and 150).

ESPER_WING.name: Esper Wing
ESPER_WING.effect: The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings, boosting its Speed stat. This move’s critical-hit ratio is also boosted by 1 stage.

EXPANDING_FORCE.name: Expanding Force
EXPANDING_FORCE.effect: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. If the user is under the effect of Psychic Terrain, this move’s power is boosted by 50% and its range extends to all opponents.

EXPLOSION.name: Explosion
EXPLOSION.effect: The user attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

EXTRASENSORY.name: Extrasensory
EXTRASENSORY.effect: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. This move has a 10% chance of making the target flinch.

EXTREME_SPEED.name: Extreme Speed
EXTREME_SPEED.effect: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

FACADE.name: Facade
FACADE.effect: This move’s power is doubled if the user is poisoned, badly poisoned, burned, or paralyzed. Although this move is a physical move, the damage it deals is not halved when the user is burned.

FAIRY_WIND.name: Fairy Wind
FAIRY_WIND.effect: The user attacks by stirring up a fairy wind to strike the target.

FAKE_OUT.name: Fake Out
FAKE_OUT.effect: This attack hits first and makes the target flinch. It works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.

FAKE_TEARS.name: Fake Tears
FAKE_TEARS.effect: The user feigns crying to fluster the target. This harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

FALSE_SURRENDER.name: False Surrender
FALSE_SURRENDER.effect: The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the target with its disheveled hair. This attack never misses.

FEATHER_DANCE.name: Feather Dance
FEATHER_DANCE.effect: The user covers the target’s body with a mass of down that harshly lowers its Attack stat.

FEINT.name: Feint
FEINT.effect: This move can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect and removes the effects of those moves.

FEINT_ATTACK.name: Feint Attack
FEINT_ATTACK.effect: The user approaches the target disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. This attack never misses.

FELL_STINGER.name: Fell Stinger
FELL_STINGER.effect: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user’s Attack stat is boosted drastically.

FICKLE_BEAM.name: Fickle Beam
FICKLE_BEAM.effect: The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. There is a 30% chance that all of the user’s heads will shoot beams in unison, doubling the move’s power.

FIERY_DANCE.name: Fiery Dance
FIERY_DANCE.effect: Cloaked in flames, the user dances and attacks the target. This move has a 50% chance of boosting the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

FIERY_WRATH.name: Fiery Wrath
FIERY_WRATH.effect: The user transforms its wrath into a fire-like aura to attack. This move has a 20% chance of making targets flinch.

FILLET_AWAY.name: Fillet Away
FILLET_AWAY.effect: The user loses ½ of its max HP to sharply boost its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats. This move fails if the user doesn’t have enough remaining HP.

FIRE_BLAST.name: Fire Blast
FIRE_BLAST.effect: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This move has a 10% chance of burning the target.

FIRE_FANG.name: Fire Fang
FIRE_FANG.effect: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. This move has a 10% chance of burning the target and a 10% chance of making the target flinch.

FIRE_LASH.name: Fire Lash
FIRE_LASH.effect: The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target’s Defense stat.

FIRE_PLEDGE.name: Fire Pledge
FIRE_PLEDGE.effect: A column of fire hits the target. When used alongside Water Pledge or Grass Pledge, the moves will combine for 150 base power and summon a rainbow or vast sea of fire, respectively, for 4 turns.

FIRE_PUNCH.name: Вогняний Кулак
FIRE_PUNCH.effect: Ціль піддається атаці вогняним ударом. Цей прийом має 10% шанс підпалити ціль.

FIRE_SPIN.name: Вогневихор
FIRE_SPIN.effect: Користувач ув’язнює ціль у потужному вогняному вихорі. Протягом 4–5 ходів ціль наприкінці кожного ходу отримує шкоду, що дорівнює ⅛ від її максимального ОЗ.

FIRST_IMPRESSION.name: First Impression
FIRST_IMPRESSION.effect: The user attacks with tremendous power, but this move only succeeds if it is used first thing upon the user entering a battle.

FISSURE.name: Тріщина
FISSURE.effect: Користувач відкриває тріщину в землі й кидає туди ціль. Якщо ця атака влучає, ціль миттєво втрачає свідомість, за винятком поке́монів-босів. Точність цього прийому становить 30%.

FLAIL.name: Flail
FLAIL.effect: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 20 and 200).

FLAMETHROWER.name: Вогнемет
FLAMETHROWER.effect: Ціль обпалюється потужним струменем вогню. Цей прийом має 10% шанс підпалили ціль.

FLAME_BURST.name: Flame Burst
FLAME_BURST.effect: The user attacks the target with a bursting flame. Pokémon next to the target also take damage equal to ¹⁄₁₆ of their max HP.

FLAME_CHARGE.name: Flame Charge
FLAME_CHARGE.effect: Cloaking itself in flame, the user attacks the target. Then, building up momentum, the user boosts its Speed stat.

FLAME_WHEEL.name: Flame Wheel
FLAME_WHEEL.effect: The user attacks by cloaking itself in fire and charging at the target. This move has a 10% chance of burning the target and thaws out the user if it is frozen.

FLARE_BLITZ.name: Flare Blitz
FLARE_BLITZ.effect: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target to inflict damage. The user takes ⅓ of the damage dealt by this move. This also has a 10% chance of burning the target and thaws out the user if it is frozen.

FLASH.name: Flash
FLASH.effect: The user flashes a bright light that lowers the target’s accuracy.

FLASH_CANNON.name: Flash Cannon
FLASH_CANNON.effect: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it all at once. This move has a 10% chance of lowering the target’s Sp. Def stat.

FLATTER.name: Flatter
FLATTER.effect: Flattery is used to confuse the target. However, this also boosts the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

FLIP_TURN.name: Flip Turn
FLIP_TURN.effect: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

FLOATY_FALL.name: Floaty Fall
FLOATY_FALL.effect: The user floats in the air, and then dives at a steep angle to attack the target. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

FLOWER_SHIELD.name: Flower Shield
FLOWER_SHIELD.effect: The user boosts the Defense stats of all Grass-type Pokémon in battle with a mysterious power.

FLOWER_TRICK.name: Квітковий Фокус
FLOWER_TRICK.effect: Користувач кидає у ціль підроблений букет квітів. Ця атака ніколи не промахується і завжди завдає критичного удару.

FLY.name: Політ
FLY.effect: У першому ході користувач злітає в небо, а в наступному — атакує.

FLYING_PRESS.name: Flying Press
FLYING_PRESS.effect: The user dives down onto the target from the sky. This move is Fighting and Flying type simultaneously. If the target has used Minimize, this move’s power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.

FOCUS_BLAST.name: Focus Blast
FOCUS_BLAST.effect: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This move has a 10% chance of lowering the target’s Sp. Def stat.

FOCUS_ENERGY.name: Focus Energy
FOCUS_ENERGY.effect: The user takes a deep breath and focuses, gaining a 2-stage critical-hit ratio boost to its future attacks.

FORCE_PALM.name: Force Palm
FORCE_PALM.effect: The target is attacked with a shock wave. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target.

FOUL_PLAY.name: Foul Play
FOUL_PLAY.effect: The user turns the target’s strength against it. The damage dealt by this move is determined using the target’s Attack stat instead of the user’s Attack stat.

FREEZE_DRY.name: Freeze-Dry
FREEZE_DRY.effect: The user attacks by rapidly lowering target’s temperature. This move is also super effective against Water type Pokémon.

FREEZY_FROST.name: Freezy Frost
FREEZY_FROST.effect: The user attacks with a crystal made of cold frozen haze. It eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

FRENZY_PLANT.name: Frenzy Plant
FRENZY_PLANT.effect: The user slams the target with the roots of an enormous tree. The user can’t move on the next turn.

FROST_BREATH.name: Frost Breath
FROST_BREATH.effect: The user attacks by blowing its cold breath on the target. This move always lands a critical hit.

FURY_ATTACK.name: Атака Люті
FURY_ATTACK.effect: Користувач атакує, наносячи удари рогом, дзьобом або подібним органом. Цей прийом завдає 2–5 ударів поспіль.

FURY_CUTTER.name: Fury Cutter
FURY_CUTTER.effect: The user attacks by slashing the target with scythes, claws, or the like. This move’s power is doubled if it hits in succession, up to a max of 160 power, and resets if this move is interrupted or another move is used.

FURY_SWIPES.name: Fury Swipes
FURY_SWIPES.effect: The user attacks by raking the target with claws, scythes, or the like. This move hits 2-5 times in a row.

FUSION_BOLT.name: Fusion Bolt
FUSION_BOLT.effect: The user throws down a giant lightning bolt. This move’s power is doubled if used after Fusion Flare.

FUSION_FLARE.name: Fusion Flare
FUSION_FLARE.effect: The user brings down a giant flame. This move’s power is doubled if used after Fusion Bolt. The user is thawed out if it is frozen.

FUTURE_SIGHT.name: Future Sight
FUTURE_SIGHT.effect: 2 turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

GEOMANCY.name: Geomancy
GEOMANCY.effect: The user absorbs energy on the first turn, then sharply boosts its Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats on the next turn.

GIGATON_HAMMER.name: Gigaton Hammer
GIGATON_HAMMER.effect: The user swings its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move can’t be used twice in a row.

GIGA_DRAIN.name: Giga Drain
GIGA_DRAIN.effect: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

GIGA_IMPACT.name: Giga Impact
GIGA_IMPACT.effect: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can’t move on the next turn.

GLAIVE_RUSH.name: Glaive Rush
GLAIVE_RUSH.effect: The user throws its entire body into a reckless charge. After this move is used, attacks on the user cannot miss and will inflict double damage until the user’s next turn.

GLARE.name: Glare
GLARE.effect: The user intimidates the target with a frightful glare that will leave it paralyzed.

GLITZY_GLOW.name: Glitzy Glow
GLITZY_GLOW.effect: The user bombards the target with telekinetic force. A wondrous wall of light is put up to halve the damage taken from special moves. In Double Battles, this damage is reduced by ⅓ instead.

GRASSY_GLIDE.name: Grassy Glide
GRASSY_GLIDE.effect: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. If the user is under the effect of Grassy Terrain, this move always goes first.

GRASSY_TERRAIN.name: Grassy Terrain
GRASSY_TERRAIN.effect: Turns the entire field into Grassy Terrain for 5 turns. Pokémon on the ground have the power of their Grass-type moves boosted by 30% and they have ¹⁄₁₆ of their max HP restored at the end of every turn.

GRASS_KNOT.name: Grass Knot
GRASS_KNOT.effect: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 20 and 120).

GRASS_PLEDGE.name: Grass Pledge
GRASS_PLEDGE.effect: A column of grass hits the target. When used alongside Water Pledge or Fire Pledge, the moves will combine for 150 base power and summon a vast swamp or sea of fire, respectively, for 4 turns.

GRASS_WHISTLE.name: Grass Whistle
GRASS_WHISTLE.effect: The user plays a pleasant melody that puts the target to sleep.

GRAV_APPLE.name: Grav Apple
GRAV_APPLE.effect: The user inflicts damage by dropping an apple from high above. This also lowers the target’s Defense stat. This move’s power is boosted by 50% when Gravity is active.

GROWL.name: Гримання
GROWL.effect: Користувач мило гарчить, завдяки чому поке́мони супротивники стають менш обережними. Це знижує їхні показники атаки.

GROWTH.name: Ріст
GROWTH.effect: Тіло користувача раптово збільшується, що підвищує його показники Атаки та Спец. Атаки. У умовах сонця ці показники, навпаки, різко зростуть.

GUILLOTINE.name: Гільйотина
GUILLOTINE.effect: Жорстока атака, що розриває супротивника великими клешнями. Якщо ця атака влучає, ціль миттєво знепритомніє, за винятком Поке́монів-босів. Точність цього прийому становить 30%.

GUNK_SHOT.name: Gunk Shot
GUNK_SHOT.effect: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. This move has a 30% chance of poisoning the target.

GUST.name: Шквал
GUST.effect: Крилами створюється порив вітру, який спрямовується на ціль, завдаючи їй шкоди. Цей прийом може вразити ціль, що перебуває в повітрі завдяки прийомам «Політ», «Відскок» або «Падіння з Неба», причому сила удару подвоюється.

GYRO_BALL.name: Gyro Ball
GYRO_BALL.effect: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user is than the target, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 1 and 150).

HAIL.name: Hail
HAIL.effect: The user summons a hailstorm lasting 5 turns. All Pokémon except Ice types will be damaged for ¹⁄₁₆ of their max HP at the end of every turn.

HAMMER_ARM.name: Hammer Arm
HAMMER_ARM.effect: The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user’s Speed stat.

HARDEN.name: Затвердіння
HARDEN.effect: Користувач напружує всі м’язи свого тіла, щоб підвищити показник Захисту

HARD_PRESS.name: Hard Press
HARD_PRESS.effect: The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 1 and 100).

HAZE.name: Haze
HAZE.effect: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

HEADBUTT.name: Удар Головою
HEADBUTT.effect: Користувач висуває голову і атакує, кидаючись прямо на ціль. Цей прийом має 30% шансів змусити ціль збитися з дії.

HEADLONG_RUSH.name: Headlong Rush
HEADLONG_RUSH.effect: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

HEAD_CHARGE.name: Head Charge
HEAD_CHARGE.effect: The user charges its head into the target, using its powerful guard hair. The user takes ¼ of the damage dealt by this move.

HEAD_SMASH.name: Head Smash
HEAD_SMASH.effect: The user attacks the target with a hazardous full-power headbutt. The user takes ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

HEAL_BELL.name: Heal Bell
HEAL_BELL.effect: The user makes a soothing bell chime to cure the status conditions of all its fellow party Pokémon and allies.

HEAL_PULSE.name: Heal Pulse
HEAL_PULSE.effect: The user emits a healing pulse that restores ½ of the target’s max HP.

HEART_STAMP.name: Heart Stamp
HEART_STAMP.effect: The user unleashes a vicious blow after its cute act makes the target less wary. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

HEAT_CRASH.name: Heat Crash
HEAT_CRASH.effect: The user slams into the target with its flame-covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 40 and 120). If the target has used Minimize, this move’s power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.

HEAT_WAVE.name: Heat Wave
HEAT_WAVE.effect: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This move has a 10% chance of burning targets.

HEAVY_SLAM.name: Heavy Slam
HEAVY_SLAM.effect: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 40 and 120). If the target has used Minimize, this move’s power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.

HEX.name: Hex
HEX.effect: The user attacks with relentless intensity. This move’s power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

HIDDEN_POWER.name: Hidden Power
HIDDEN_POWER.effect: A unique attack that varies in type depending on the Pokémon using it.

HIGH_HORSEPOWER.name: High Horsepower
HIGH_HORSEPOWER.effect: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

HIGH_JUMP_KICK.name: High Jump Kick
HIGH_JUMP_KICK.effect: The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If this move misses or fails, the user takes damage equal to ½ of its max HP.

HONE_CLAWS.name: Hone Claws
HONE_CLAWS.effect: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.

HORN_ATTACK.name: Атака Рогами
HORN_ATTACK.effect: У ціль встромляють гострий ріг, щоб завдати шкоди.

HORN_DRILL.name: Ріг Дриль
HORN_DRILL.effect: Користувач проколює ціль рогом, що обертається, наче дриль. Якщо ця атака влучає, ціль миттєво знепритомніє, за винятком Поке́монів-босів. Точність цього прийому становить 30%.

HORN_LEECH.name: Horn Leech
HORN_LEECH.effect: The user drains the target’s energy with its horns. The user’s HP is restored by ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

HOWL.name: Howl
HOWL.effect: The user howls loudly to rouse itself and its allies. This boosts their Attack stats.

HURRICANE.name: Hurricane
HURRICANE.effect: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind. This move has a 30% chance of confusing the target, and never misses in rain. This move can also hit a target that’s in the air from Fly, Bounce, or Sky Drop.

HYDRO_CANNON.name: Hydro Cannon
HYDRO_CANNON.effect: The target is hit with a watery blast. The user can’t move on the next turn.

HYDRO_PUMP.name: Гідронасос
HYDRO_PUMP.effect: Ціль піддається удару величезного об’єму води, що вистрілюється під великим тиском.

HYDRO_STEAM.name: Hydro Steam
HYDRO_STEAM.effect: The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move’s power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50%.

HYPER_BEAM.name: Гіперпромінь
HYPER_BEAM.effect: На ціль наноситься удар потужним променем. У наступному ході користувач не може рухатися.

HYPER_FANG.name: Hyper Fang
HYPER_FANG.effect: The user bites hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This move has a 10% chance of making the target flinch.

HYPER_VOICE.name: Hyper Voice
HYPER_VOICE.effect: The user attacks by letting loose a horribly loud, resounding cry.

HYPNOSIS.name: Гіпноз
HYPNOSIS.effect: Користувач застосовує гіпнотичні навіювання, щоб змусити ціль заснути.

ICE_BALL.name: Ice Ball
ICE_BALL.effect: The user continually rolls into the target over 5 turns. This attack doubles in power each time it hits, and resets after 5 turns have passed or if the move is interrupted.

ICE_BEAM.name: Крижаний Промінь
ICE_BEAM.effect: Ціль вражається крижаним енергетичним променем. Цей прийом має 10% шанс заморозити ціль.

ICE_FANG.name: Ice Fang
ICE_FANG.effect: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This move has a 10% chance of freezing the target and a 10% chance of making the target flinch.

ICE_HAMMER.name: Ice Hammer
ICE_HAMMER.effect: The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user’s Speed stat.

ICE_PUNCH.name: Ледяний Кулак
ICE_PUNCH.effect: Ціль атакується крижаним ударом. Цей прийом має 10% шанс заморозити ціль.

ICE_SHARD.name: Ice Shard
ICE_SHARD.effect: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.

ICE_SPINNER.name: Ice Spinner
ICE_SPINNER.effect: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move’s spinning motion also destroys the terrain.

ICICLE_CRASH.name: Icicle Crash
ICICLE_CRASH.effect: The user attacks by crashing large icicles onto the target. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

ICICLE_SPEAR.name: Icicle Spear
ICICLE_SPEAR.effect: The user attacks by launching sharp icicles at the target. This move hits 2-5 times in a row.

ICY_WIND.name: Icy Wind
ICY_WIND.effect: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon’s Speed stats.

INCINERATE.name: Incinerate
INCINERATE.effect: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with fire. If a Pokémon is holding a certain item, such as a Berry, the item becomes burned up and unusable.

INFERNO.name: Inferno
INFERNO.effect: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. This leaves the target with a burn.

INFESTATION.name: Infestation
INFESTATION.effect: The target is infested and attacked. For 4-5 turns, the target takes damage equal to ⅛ of its max HP at the end of every turn. The target can’t flee or be switched out of battle during this time.

IRON_DEFENSE.name: Iron Defense
IRON_DEFENSE.effect: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

IRON_HEAD.name: Iron Head
IRON_HEAD.effect: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This move has a 20% chance of making the target flinch.

IRON_TAIL.name: Iron Tail
IRON_TAIL.effect: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This move has a 30% chance of lowering the target’s Defense stat.

IVY_CUDGEL.name: Ivy Cudgel
IVY_CUDGEL.effect: The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel, this move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage. When used by Ogerpon, this move’s type changes depending on the mask worn.

JAW_LOCK.name: Jaw Lock
JAW_LOCK.effect: This move prevents the user and the target from switching out until either of them faints. The effect goes away if either of the Pokémon leaves the field.

JET_PUNCH.name: Jet Punch
JET_PUNCH.effect: The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

JUDGMENT.name: Judgment
JUDGMENT.effect: The user releases countless shots of light at the target. This move’s type changes depending on the kind of Plate or Memory Disc the user is holding, if it has the Multitype or RKS System ability.

JUMP_KICK.name: Пінок в Прижке
JUMP_KICK.effect: Користувач високо підстрибує, а потім завдає удару ногою. Якщо цей прийом промахується або не вдається, користувач отримує шкоду, що дорівнює ½ його максимального ОЗ.

KARATE_CHOP.name: Удар Карате
KARATE_CHOP.effect: Ціль атакується різким ударом. Шанс нанесення критичного удару при виконанні цього прийому підвищується на 1 рівень.

KINESIS.name: Kinesis
KINESIS.effect: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. This lowers the target’s accuracy.

KINGS_SHIELD.name: King’s Shield
KINGS_SHIELD.effect: The user takes a defensive stance while it protects itself from damage. Any attackers that use contact moves against the user during this turn will have their Attack stats lowered. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

KNOCK_OFF.name: Knock Off
KNOCK_OFF.effect: The user slaps down a target’s held item, removing the item. This move’s power is boosted by 50% if the target has a held item.

KOWTOW_CLEAVE.name: Kowtow Cleave
KOWTOW_CLEAVE.effect: The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.

LANDS_WRATH.name: Land’s Wrath
LANDS_WRATH.effect: The user gathers the energy of the land and focuses that power on opposing Pokémon to inflict damage.

LASH_OUT.name: Lash Out
LASH_OUT.effect: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. This move’s power is doubled if the user’s stats were lowered during this turn.

LAST_RESPECTS.name: Last Respects
LAST_RESPECTS.effect: The user attacks to avenge its allies. This move’s power is increased by 50 for each time that a Pokémon in the user’s party has fainted.

LAVA_PLUME.name: Lava Plume
LAVA_PLUME.effect: The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. This move has a 30% chance of burning targets.

LEAFAGE.name: Leafage
LEAFAGE.effect: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.

LEAF_BLADE.name: Leaf Blade
LEAF_BLADE.effect: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and cuts the target to inflict damage. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

LEAF_STORM.name: Leaf Storm
LEAF_STORM.effect: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

LEAF_TORNADO.name: Leaf Tornado
LEAF_TORNADO.effect: The user attacks its target by encircling it in sharp leaves. This move has a 50% chance of lowering the target’s accuracy.

LEECH_LIFE.name: Leech Life
LEECH_LIFE.effect: The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is restored by ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

LEECH_SEED.name: Сімейна-Піявки
LEECH_SEED.effect: На ціль висаджується насіння. Наприкінці кожного ходу ⅛ від максимального ОЗ цілі поглинається користувачем або будь-яким поке́моном, який займає його місце в бою.

LEER.name: Грізний Погляд
LEER.effect: Користувач кидає на поке́монів супротивників. загрозливий погляд, що знижує їхні показники захисту.

LICK.name: Lick
LICK.effect: The user licks the target with a long tongue to inflict damage. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target.

LIFE_DEW.name: Life Dew
LIFE_DEW.effect: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores ¼ of the user and its ally Pokémon’s max HP.

LIGHT_OF_RUIN.name: Light of Ruin
LIGHT_OF_RUIN.effect: Drawing in mystical energy, the user fires a powerful beam of light. The user takes ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

LIGHT_SCREEN.name: Light Screen
LIGHT_SCREEN.effect: A wondrous wall of light is put up to halve the damage taken from special moves for 5 turns. In Double Battles, this damage is reduced by ⅓ instead.

LIQUIDATION.name: Liquidation
LIQUIDATION.effect: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This move has a 20% chance of lowering the target’s Defense stat.

LOVELY_KISS.name: Lovely Kiss
LOVELY_KISS.effect: With a scary face, the user tries to kiss the target. If it succeeds, the target falls asleep.

LOW_KICK.name: Підножка
LOW_KICK.effect: Потужний удар ногою вниз, який збиває ціль з ніг. Чим важча ціль, тим більша сила цього прийому (від 20 до 120).

LOW_SWEEP.name: Low Sweep
LOW_SWEEP.effect: The user makes a swift attack on the target’s legs, which lowers the target’s Speed stat.

LUMINA_CRASH.name: Lumina Crash
LUMINA_CRASH.effect: The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar light that even affects the mind. This also harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

LUNGE.name: Lunge
LUNGE.effect: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

LUSTER_PURGE.name: Luster Purge
LUSTER_PURGE.effect: The user lets loose a damaging burst of light. This move has a 50% chance of lowering the target’s Sp. Def stat.

MACH_PUNCH.name: Mach Punch
MACH_PUNCH.effect: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

MAGICAL_LEAF.name: Magical Leaf
MAGICAL_LEAF.effect: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.

MAGICAL_TORQUE.name: Magical Torque
MAGICAL_TORQUE.effect: The user rams into the target with a fae-like force. This move has a 30% chance of confusing the target.

MAGNETIC_FLUX.name: Magnetic Flux
MAGNETIC_FLUX.effect: The user manipulates magnetic fields, which boosts the Defense and Sp. Def stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus Ability or the Minus Ability.

MAGNET_BOMB.name: Magnet Bomb
MAGNET_BOMB.effect: The user launches steel bombs that stick to the target. This attack never misses.

MAGNITUDE.name: Magnitude
MAGNITUDE.effect: The user attacks everything around it with a ground-shaking quake. Its power varies based on the magnitude of the quake, with the possibility of being 10, 30, 50, 70, 90, 110, or 150 power. This move’s power is doubled against targets underground from Dig, and halved while Grassy Terrain is active.

MAKE_IT_RAIN.name: Make It Rain
MAKE_IT_RAIN.effect: The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat. If a target is successfully struck, you will earn money after the battle.

MALIGNANT_CHAIN.name: Malignant Chain
MALIGNANT_CHAIN.effect: The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This move has a 50% chance of badly poisoning the target.

MATCHA_GOTCHA.name: Matcha Gotcha
MATCHA_GOTCHA.effect: The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user’s HP is restored by ½ of the damage dealt by this move, and has a 20% chance of burning targets. This will also thaw out a frozen user or target.

MEDITATE.name: Медитація
MEDITATE.effect: Користувач медитує, щоб пробудити силу, приховану в глибинах свого тіла, і таким чином підвищити свій показник Атаки.

MEGAHORN.name: Megahorn
MEGAHORN.effect: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

MEGA_DRAIN.name: Мега-Висиханння
MEGA_DRAIN.effect: Атака, що висмоктує поживні речовини. ОЗ користувача відновлюється на ½ від шкоди, завданої цим прийомом.

MEGA_KICK.name: Мега Пінок
MEGA_KICK.effect: Ціль піддається удару ногою, виконаному з величезною силою.

MEGA_PUNCH.name: Мега Кулак
MEGA_PUNCH.effect: Ціль отримує удар кулаком, нанесений з величезною силою.

MEMENTO.name: Memento
MEMENTO.effect: The user faints. In return, the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats are harshly lowered.

METAL_CLAW.name: Metal Claw
METAL_CLAW.effect: The target is raked with steel claws. This move has a 10% chance of boosting the user’s Attack stat.

METAL_SOUND.name: Metal Sound
METAL_SOUND.effect: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

METEOR_ASSAULT.name: Meteor Assault
METEOR_ASSAULT.effect: The user attacks wildly with a long weapon. However, this also makes the user stagger, leaving it unable to move next turn.

METEOR_BEAM.name: Meteor Beam
METEOR_BEAM.effect: The user gathers energy from space and boosts its Sp. Atk stat on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

METEOR_MASH.name: Meteor Mash
METEOR_MASH.effect: The target is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. This move has a 20% chance of boosting the user’s Attack stat.

METRONOME.name: Metronome
METRONOME.effect: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

MIGHTY_CLEAVE.name: Mighty Cleave
MIGHTY_CLEAVE.effect: The user wields the light that has accumulated through its blades to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

MILK_DRINK.name: Milk Drink
MILK_DRINK.effect: The user drinks highly nutritious milk, restoring ½ of its max HP.

MINIMIZE.name: Зменшення
MINIMIZE.effect: Користувач стискає своє тіло, щоб здаватися меншим, що різко підвищує його показник ухилення. Однак це робить користувача більш вразливим до певних ударів та притискаючих прийомів.

MIRROR_SHOT.name: Mirror Shot
MIRROR_SHOT.effect: The user lets loose a flash of energy at the target from its polished body. This move has a 30% chance of lowering the target’s accuracy.

MISTY_EXPLOSION.name: Misty Explosion
MISTY_EXPLOSION.effect: The user attacks everything around it and faints upon using this move. If the user is under the effect of Misty Terrain, this move’s power is boosted by 50%.

MISTY_TERRAIN.name: Misty Terrain
MISTY_TERRAIN.effect: Turns the entire field into Misty Terrain for 5 turns. Pokémon on the ground have the power of their Dragon-type moves halved, they are immune to status conditions, and they cannot become confused.

MIST_BALL.name: Mist Ball
MIST_BALL.effect: The user attacks with a ball packed with mist-like down. This move has a 50% chance of lowering the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

MOONBLAST.name: Moonblast
MOONBLAST.effect: Borrowing the power of the moon, the user attacks the target. This move has 10% chance of lowering the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

MOONGEIST_BEAM.name: Moongeist Beam
MOONGEIST_BEAM.effect: The user emits a sinister ray to attack the target. This move can ignore a target’s ability (with certain exceptions).

MOONLIGHT.name: Moonlight
MOONLIGHT.effect: The user bathes in the soothing light of the moon, restoring ½ of its max HP. In harsh sunlight, ⅔ of its max HP will be restored instead. In all other weather conditions, ¼ of its max HP will be restored instead.

MORNING_SUN.name: Morning Sun
MORNING_SUN.effect: The user bathes in the pleasant rays of the sun, restoring ½ of its max HP. In harsh sunlight, ⅔ of its max HP will be restored instead. In all other weather conditions, ¼ of its max HP will be restored instead.

MORTAL_SPIN.name: Mortal Spin
MORTAL_SPIN.effect: The user performs a spin attack that can eliminate the effects of binding moves and Leech Seed, as well as any entry hazards on its side. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.

MOUNTAIN_GALE.name: Mountain Gale
MOUNTAIN_GALE.effect: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target to inflict damage. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

MUDDY_WATER.name: Muddy Water
MUDDY_WATER.effect: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This move has a 30% chance of lowering their accuracy.

MUD_BOMB.name: Mud Bomb
MUD_BOMB.effect: The user launches a hard-packed mud ball to attack. This move has a 30% chance of lowering the target’s accuracy.

MUD_SHOT.name: Mud Shot
MUD_SHOT.effect: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

MUD_SLAP.name: Mud-Slap
MUD_SLAP.effect: The user hurls mud in the target’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

MYSTICAL_FIRE.name: Mystical Fire
MYSTICAL_FIRE.effect: The user attacks by breathing a special kind of searing flame. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

NASTY_PLOT.name: Nasty Plot
NASTY_PLOT.effect: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

NATURES_MADNESS.name: Nature’s Madness
NATURES_MADNESS.effect: The user hits the target with the full wrath of nature. This deals damage to the target equal to ½ of their remaining HP.

NEEDLE_ARM.name: Needle Arm
NEEDLE_ARM.effect: The user attacks by wildly swinging its thorny arms. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

NIGHT_DAZE.name: Night Daze
NIGHT_DAZE.effect: The user looses a pitch-black shock wave at the target to inflict damage. This move has a 40% chance of lowering the target’s accuracy.

NIGHT_SHADE.name: Нічна Тіль
NIGHT_SHADE.effect: Користувач змушує ціль побачити страшну ілюзію. Прийом завдає шкоди, що дорівнює рівню користувача.

NIGHT_SLASH.name: Night Slash
NIGHT_SLASH.effect: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

NOBLE_ROAR.name: Noble Roar
NOBLE_ROAR.effect: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

NOXIOUS_TORQUE.name: Noxious Torque
NOXIOUS_TORQUE.effect: The user rams into the target with a poisonous end. This move has a 30% chance of poisoning the target.

NO_RETREAT.name: No Retreat
NO_RETREAT.effect: The user puts everything on the line and boosts its Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats. In exchange, the user loses the ability to flee or be switched out of battle. Can only be used once per time the user enters battle.

NUZZLE.name: Nuzzle
NUZZLE.effect: The user attacks by nuzzling its electrified cheeks against the target. This paralyzes the target.

OBLIVION_WING.name: Oblivion Wing
OBLIVION_WING.effect: The user unleashes a wave of destruction to absorb HP from target. The user’s HP is restored by ¾ of the damage dealt by this move.

OBSTRUCT.name: Obstruct
OBSTRUCT.effect: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Any attackers that use contact moves against the user during this turn will have their Defense stats harshly lowered. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

OCTAZOOKA.name: Octazooka
OCTAZOOKA.effect: The user attacks by spraying ink in the target’s face. This move has a 50% chance of lowering the target’s accuracy.

OMINOUS_WIND.name: Ominous Wind
OMINOUS_WIND.effect: The user attacks with a gust of horrible wind that makes the target’s skin crawl. This has a 10% chance of boosting the user’s Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats all at once.

ORDER_UP.name: Order Up
ORDER_UP.effect: The user attacks with elegant poise. If the user has a Tatsugiri in its mouth, this move boosts the user’s stats based on the Tatsugiri’s form: Attack for Curly Tatsugiri, Defense for Droopy, or Speed for Stretchy.

ORIGIN_PULSE.name: Origin Pulse
ORIGIN_PULSE.effect: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with countless beams of light that glow a deep and brilliant blue.

OUTRAGE.name: Outrage
OUTRAGE.effect: The user rampages and attacks for 2-3 turns. The user then becomes confused.

OVERDRIVE.name: Overdrive
OVERDRIVE.effect: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with an electrifying soundwave, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.

OVERHEAT.name: Overheat
OVERHEAT.effect: The user attacks the target with all its might. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

PARABOLIC_CHARGE.name: Parabolic Charge
PARABOLIC_CHARGE.effect: The user attacks by unleashing a wave of electricity. The user’s HP is restored by ½ of the damage dealt by this move.

PAYBACK.name: Payback
PAYBACK.effect: The user stores power, then attacks. This move’s power is doubled if the user moves after the target.

PAY_DAY.name: Потік Монет
PAY_DAY.effect: Монети кидають у ціль, щоб завдати їй шкоди. Якщо вдасться влучити в ціль, після бою ви отримаєте гроші.

PECK.name: Удар Дзьобом
PECK.effect: У ціль вдаряють гострим дзьобом або рогом, щоб завдати шкоди.

PETAL_BLIZZARD.name: Petal Blizzard
PETAL_BLIZZARD.effect: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and damages everything around it.

PETAL_DANCE.name: Танець Пелюсток
PETAL_DANCE.effect: Користувач атакує ціль, розкидаючи пелюстки протягом 2–3 ходів. Після цього користувач впадає в стан розгубленості.

PHANTOM_FORCE.name: Phantom Force
PHANTOM_FORCE.effect: The user attacks by disappearing into the shadows for a short time, then surfacing to strike the target on the next turn. This move can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect and removes the effects of those moves.

PHOTON_GEYSER.name: Photon Geyser
PHOTON_GEYSER.effect: The user attacks the target with a pillar of light. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user. This move can ignore the effect of the target’s Ability (with certain exceptions).

PIN_MISSILE.name: Голкомет
PIN_MISSILE.effect: Користувач атакує, вистрілюючи в ціль гострими шипами. Цей прийом завдає 2–5 ударів поспіль.

PLAY_NICE.name: Play Nice
PLAY_NICE.effect: The user and the target become friends, and the target loses its will to fight. This lowers the target’s Attack stat.

PLAY_ROUGH.name: Play Rough
PLAY_ROUGH.effect: The user attacks by playing rough with the target. This move has a 10% chance of lowering the target’s Attack stat.

PLUCK.name: Pluck
PLUCK.effect: The user attacks by pecking the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

POISON_FANG.name: Poison Fang
POISON_FANG.effect: The user bites the target with toxic fangs. This move has a 50% chance of badly poisoning the target.

POISON_GAS.name: Poison Gas
POISON_GAS.effect: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the faces of opposing Pokémon, poisoning those it hits.

POISON_JAB.name: Poison Jab
POISON_JAB.effect: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, an arm, or the like steeped in poison. This move has a 30% chance of poisoning the target.

POISON_POWDER.name: Ядовитий Пиль
POISON_POWDER.effect: Користувач розпилює хмару отруйного пилу, яка вражає ціль.

POISON_STING.name: Отруйне Жало
POISON_STING.effect: Користувач встромляє в ціль отруйне жало, щоб завдати шкоди. Цей прийом має 30% шанс отруїти ціль.

POISON_TAIL.name: Poison Tail
POISON_TAIL.effect: The user hits the target with its tail. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage and has a 10% chance of poisoning the target.

POLLEN_PUFF.name: Pollen Puff
POLLEN_PUFF.effect: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. When used on an ally, this move restores ½ of its max HP instead of dealing damage.

POUNCE.name: Pounce
POUNCE.effect: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

POUND.name: Важкий Удар
POUND.effect: У ціль наносять удари довгим хвостом, передньою лапою тощо.

POWDER_SNOW.name: Powder Snow
POWDER_SNOW.effect: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with a chilling gust of powdery snow. This move has a 10% chance of freezing targets.

POWER_GEM.name: Power Gem
POWER_GEM.effect: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

POWER_TRIP.name: Power Trip
POWER_TRIP.effect: The user boasts its strength and attacks the target. This move’s power is increased by 20 for each stage that the user’s stats have been boosted.

POWER_UP_PUNCH.name: Power-Up Punch
POWER_UP_PUNCH.effect: The user attacks targets with a punch that will make its own fist tougher. This boosts the user’s Attack stat.

POWER_WHIP.name: Power Whip
POWER_WHIP.effect: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to lash the target.

PRECIPICE_BLADES.name: Precipice Blades
PRECIPICE_BLADES.effect: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by manifesting the power of the land in fearsome blades of stone.

PROTECT.name: Protect
PROTECT.effect: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes ⅓ of what it was before.

PSYBEAM.name: Психопромінь
PSYBEAM.effect: На ціль наноситься удар особливим променем. Цей прийом має 10% шанс збити ціль з пантелику.

PSYBLADE.name: Psyblade
PSYBLADE.effect: The user rends the target with an ethereal blade. This move’s power is boosted by 50% if the user is on Electric Terrain.

PSYCHIC.name: Психокінез
PSYCHIC.effect: На ціль спрямовується потужна телекінетична сила, що завдає шкоди. Цей прийом має 10% шанс знизити показник Спец. Захисту цілі.

PSYCHIC_FANGS.name: Psychic Fangs
PSYCHIC_FANGS.effect: The user attacks by biting targets using psychic power. This move can also break barriers such as Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil.

PSYCHIC_NOISE.name: Psychic Noise
PSYCHIC_NOISE.effect: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For 2 turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.

PSYCHIC_TERRAIN.name: Psychic Terrain
PSYCHIC_TERRAIN.effect: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for 5 turns.

PSYCHO_CUT.name: Psycho Cut
PSYCHO_CUT.effect: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

PSYSHIELD_BASH.name: Psyshield Bash
PSYSHIELD_BASH.effect: Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This also boosts the user’s Defense stat.

PSYSHOCK.name: Psyshock
PSYSHOCK.effect: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.

PSYSTRIKE.name: Psystrike
PSYSTRIKE.effect: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.

PSYWAVE.name: Psywave
PSYWAVE.effect: The target is attacked with an odd psychic wave. This attack varies in damage, ranging from 50% to 150% of the user’s level.

PUNISHMENT.name: Punishment
PUNISHMENT.effect: This move’s power is increased by 20 for each stage that the target’s stats have been boosted.

PURSUIT.name: Pursuit
PURSUIT.effect: The power of this attack move is doubled if it’s used on a target that’s switching out of battle.

PYRO_BALL.name: Pyro Ball
PYRO_BALL.effect: The user attacks by igniting a small stone and launching it as a fiery ball at the target. This move has a 10% chance of burning the target and thaws out the user if it is frozen.

QUICK_ATTACK.name: Швидка Атака
QUICK_ATTACK.effect: Користувач кидається на ціль, щоб завдати шкоди, рухаючись з блискавичною швидкістю. Цей хід має пріоритет 1.

QUIVER_DANCE.name: Quiver Dance
QUIVER_DANCE.effect: The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. This boosts the user’s Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.

RAGE.name: Гнів
RAGE.effect: Поки цей прийом активний, сила гніву підвищує показник Атаки щоразу, коли користувач отримує удар у бою.

RAGING_FURY.name: Raging Fury
RAGING_FURY.effect: The user rampages around spewing flames for 2-3 turns. The user then becomes confused.

RAIN_DANCE.name: Rain Dance
RAIN_DANCE.effect: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for 5 turns, powering up Water-type moves by 50%. The rain also halves the damage dealt by Fire-type moves.

RAPID_SPIN.name: Rapid Spin
RAPID_SPIN.effect: The user performs a spin attack that can eliminate the effects of binding moves and Leech Seed, as well as any entry hazards on its side. This also boosts the user’s Speed stat.

RAZOR_LEAF.name: Листя-Лезвія
RAZOR_LEAF.effect: Листя з гострими краями вистрілюють, щоб розрізати поке́монів супротивників. Шанс нанесення критичного удару цим прийомом підвищується на 1 рівень.

RAZOR_SHELL.name: Razor Shell
RAZOR_SHELL.effect: The user cuts the target with sharp shells to inflict damage. This move has a 50% chance of lowering the target’s Defense stat.

RAZOR_WIND.name: Бритва-Вітер
RAZOR_WIND.effect: Після використання цього прийому користувач атакує в наступному ході за допомогою лез вітру. Шанс нанесення критичного удару цим прийомом підвищується на 1 рівень

RECOVER.name: Регенерація
RECOVER.effect: Користувач регенерує свої клітини, відновлюючи ½ від максимального ОЗ.

REFLECT.name: Reflect
REFLECT.effect: A wondrous wall of light is put up to halve the damage taken from physical moves for 5 turns. In Double Battles, this damage is reduced by ⅓ instead.

RELIC_SONG.name: Relic Song
RELIC_SONG.effect: The user sings an ancient song and attacks by appealing to the hearts of the listening opposing Pokémon. This move has a 10% chance of putting the target to sleep. If used by Meloetta, it will cause it to swap between its Aria and Pirouette Formes.

REST.name: Rest
REST.effect: The user goes to sleep for 2 turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and cures any status conditions. This move fails if the user’s HP is full.

RETALIATE.name: Retaliate
RETALIATE.effect: The user takes revenge for a fainted ally. This move’s power is doubled if an ally fainted in the previous turn.

RETURN.name: Return
RETURN.effect: This full-power attack grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer (ranging between 1 and 102).

REVENGE.name: Revenge
REVENGE.effect: The user moves last. The power of this move is doubled if the target has inflicted damage on the user in the same turn.

REVERSAL.name: Reversal
REVERSAL.effect: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has (ranging between 20 and 200).

RISING_VOLTAGE.name: Rising Voltage
RISING_VOLTAGE.effect: The user attacks with electricity rising from the ground. This move’s power is doubled if the target is under the effect of Electric Terrain.

ROAR_OF_TIME.name: Roar of Time
ROAR_OF_TIME.effect: The user blasts the target with power that distorts even time. The user can’t move on the next turn.

ROCK_BLAST.name: Rock Blast
ROCK_BLAST.effect: The user attacks by hurling hard rocks at the target. This move hits 2-5 times in a row.

ROCK_CLIMB.name: Rock Climb
ROCK_CLIMB.effect: The user attacks the target by smashing into it with incredible force. This move has a 20% chance of confusing the target.

ROCK_POLISH.name: Rock Polish
ROCK_POLISH.effect: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. This sharply boosts the user’s Speed stat.

ROCK_SLIDE.name: Rock Slide
ROCK_SLIDE.effect: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This move has a 30% chance of making the targets flinch.

ROCK_SMASH.name: Rock Smash
ROCK_SMASH.effect: The user attacks with a punch. This move has a 50% chance of lowering the target’s Defense stat.

ROCK_THROW.name: Кидок Кругляка
ROCK_THROW.effect: Користувач підбирає невеликий камінь і кидає його у ціль, щоб завдати шкоди.

ROCK_TOMB.name: Rock Tomb
ROCK_TOMB.effect: The user hurls boulders at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat by cutting off its movement.

ROCK_WRECKER.name: Rock Wrecker
ROCK_WRECKER.effect: The user launches a huge boulder at the target to attack. The user can’t move on the next turn.

ROLLOUT.name: Rollout
ROLLOUT.effect: The user continually rolls into the target over 5 turns. This attack doubles in power each time it hits, and resets after 5 turns have passed or if the move is interrupted.

ROOST.name: Roost
ROOST.effect: The user lands and rests its body, restoring ½ of its max HP. If the user is a Flying type, it will lose the Flying type for the turn.

ROTOTILLER.name: Rototiller
ROTOTILLER.effect: Tilling the soil, the user makes it easier for plants to grow. This boosts the Attack and Sp. Atk stats of all grounded Grass-type Pokémon in battle.

ROUND.name: Round
ROUND.effect: The user attacks the target with a song. If others use this move, they will act immediately after the initial user, and the power of their Rounds will be doubled.

RUINATION.name: Ruination
RUINATION.effect: The user summons a ruinous disaster. This deals damage to the target equal to ½ of their remaining HP.

SACRED_FIRE.name: Sacred Fire
SACRED_FIRE.effect: The target is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. This move has a 50% chance of burning the target and thaws out the user if it is frozen.

SACRED_SWORD.name: Sacred Sword
SACRED_SWORD.effect: The user attacks by slicing with a sword. This move ignores the target’s stat changes when dealing damage.

SALT_CURE.name: Salt Cure
SALT_CURE.effect: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage equal to ¹⁄₁₆ of the target’s max HP at the end of every turn. Steel and Water types take damage equal to ⅛ of their max HP instead.

SANDSEAR_STORM.name: Sandsear Storm
SANDSEAR_STORM.effect: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds and searingly hot sand. This move has a 20% chance of burning targets, and never misses in rain.

SANDSTORM.name: Sandstorm
SANDSTORM.effect: The user summons a sandstorm for 5 turns, Pokémon that are not Rock, Ground, or Steel types take damage equal to ¹⁄₁₆ of their max HP at the end of every turn. The sandstorm also boosts the Sp. Def stats of Rock types by 50%.

SAND_ATTACK.name: Піщана Атака
SAND_ATTACK.effect: Пісок кидається в обличчя цілі, знижуючи її влучність.

SAND_TOMB.name: Sand Tomb
SAND_TOMB.effect: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm. For 4-5 turns, the target takes damage equal to ⅛ of its max HP at the end of every turn.

SAPPY_SEED.name: Sappy Seed
SAPPY_SEED.effect: The user grows a gigantic stalk that scatters seeds to attack the target. At the end of every turn, ⅛ of the target’s max HP gets absorbed by the user or any Pokémon that takes its place in battle.

SCALD.name: Scald
SCALD.effect: The user attacks by shooting boiling hot water at the target. This move has a 30% chance of burning the target and will thaw out the user or target if one is frozen.

SCALE_SHOT.name: Scale Shot
SCALE_SHOT.effect: The user attacks by shooting scales 2-5 times in a row. This move boosts the user’s Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.

SCARY_FACE.name: Scary Face
SCARY_FACE.effect: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

SCORCHING_SANDS.name: Scorching Sands
SCORCHING_SANDS.effect: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This move has a 30% chance of burning the target and will thaw out the user or target if one is frozen.

SCRATCH.name: Подряпання
SCRATCH.effect: Тверді, загострені, гострі кігті дряпають ціль, завдаючи їй шкоди.

SCREECH.name: Скрип
SCREECH.effect: Пронизливий вереск різко знижує показник захисту цілі.

SECRET_POWER.name: Secret Power
SECRET_POWER.effect: The additional effects of this attack depend upon the biome or terrain it was used in.

SECRET_SWORD.name: Secret Sword
SECRET_SWORD.effect: The user attacks by slashing targets with a long sword. The odd power contained in the sword does physical damage to the target. If a Keldeo knows this move, it will transform into its Resolute form.

SEED_BOMB.name: Seed Bomb
SEED_BOMB.effect: The user attacks by slamming a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

SEISMIC_TOSS.name: Сейсмічний Кидок
SEISMIC_TOSS.effect: Ціль кидається за допомогою сили тяжіння. Вона завдає шкоди, що дорівнює рівню користувача.

SELF_DESTRUCT.name: Self-Destruct
SELF_DESTRUCT.effect: The user attacks everything around it by causing an explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

SHADOW_BALL.name: Shadow Ball
SHADOW_BALL.effect: The user attacks by hurling a shadowy blob at the target. This move has a 20% chance of lowering the target’s Sp. Def stat.

SHADOW_CLAW.name: Shadow Claw
SHADOW_CLAW.effect: The user attacks by slashing the target with a sharp claw made from shadows. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.

SHADOW_FORCE.name: Shadow Force
SHADOW_FORCE.effect: The user disappears on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn. This move can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect and removes the effects of those moves.

SHADOW_PUNCH.name: Shadow Punch
SHADOW_PUNCH.effect: The user throws a punch from the shadows. This attack never misses.

SHADOW_SNEAK.name: Shadow Sneak
SHADOW_SNEAK.effect: The user extends its shadow and attacks the target from behind. This move always goes first.

SHARPEN.name: Sharpen
SHARPEN.effect: The user makes its edges more jagged, which boosts its Attack stat.

SHEER_COLD.name: Sheer Cold
